name: Corn & Soybean Futures: Price Levels & Year-over-Year Comparison
description: Research study comparing absolute price levels for Corn (ZC) and Soybean (ZS) continuous futures. Shows current prices, 20-day moving averages, year-over-year dollar and percent changes, and 52-week high/low levels. Includes summary snapshot table, combined price trajectory chart, and per-commodity detail charts with MA and lagged-price reference lines.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN & SOYBEAN FUTURES: PRICE LEVELS & YEAR-OVER-YEAR COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Compares ZC (Corn) and ZS (Soybean) continuous futures prices.
# ZC = primary asset via market_data_source + futures_continuation
# ZS = reference asset via reference_futures
#
# Metrics: current price, price 1yr ago, YoY $ and % change, 52-wk high/low
# Visuals: summary table, combined trajectory chart, per-commodity detail charts
# =============================================================================

# --- ZC Data (primary asset) ---
zc_src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zc_src.o, zc_src.h, zc_src.l, zc_src.c, zc_src.v, zc_src.oi, zc_src.s)
zc_close = zc_cont.c

# --- ZS Data (reference futures) ---
zs_src = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
zs_close = zs_src.c

# --- Derived Metrics for ZC ---
zc_price_1yr_ago = zc_close >> 252
zc_yoy_dollar = zc_close - zc_price_1yr_ago
zc_yoy_pct = (zc_close / zc_price_1yr_ago) - 1
zc_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zc_close)
zc_52wk_high = max(period=252)(zc_close)
zc_52wk_low = min(period=252)(zc_close)

# --- Derived Metrics for ZS ---
zs_price_1yr_ago = zs_close >> 252
zs_yoy_dollar = zs_close - zs_price_1yr_ago
zs_yoy_pct = (zs_close / zs_price_1yr_ago) - 1
zs_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zs_close)
zs_52wk_high = max(period=252)(zs_close)
zs_52wk_low = min(period=252)(zs_close)

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# 1. SUMMARY TABLE — YoY Snapshot for both ZC and ZS
#    Rows: Corn, Soybeans
#    Cols: Current Price, Price 1yr Ago, YoY $ Change, YoY % Change,
#          52-Week High, 52-Week Low
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    category='1. YoY Snapshot',
    order=1,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Grain Futures: Year-over-Year Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=6,
        row_headers=['Corn (ZC)', 'Soybeans (ZS)'],
        col_headers=['Current Price', 'Price 1yr Ago', 'YoY $ Change', 'YoY % Change', '52-Wk High', '52-Wk Low'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC Price', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC 1yr Ago', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC YoY $', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC YoY %', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC 52wk Hi', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZC 52wk Lo', grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS Price', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS 1yr Ago', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS YoY $', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS YoY %', grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS 52wk Hi', grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS 52wk Lo', grid_row=1, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(zc_close, zc_price_1yr_ago, zc_yoy_dollar, zc_yoy_pct, zc_52wk_high, zc_52wk_low, zs_close, zs_price_1yr_ago, zs_yoy_dollar, zs_yoy_pct, zs_52wk_high, zs_52wk_low)

# =============================================================================
# 2. COMBINED PRICE TRAJECTORIES
#    Both ZC and ZS closing prices on the same chart.
#    Note: ZC ~400-600 and ZS ~900-1400 so they occupy different Y ranges,
#    but sharing a chart shows directional co-movement.
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn vs Soybeans: Price Trajectories',
    category='1. YoY Snapshot',
    y_axis_label='Price (cents/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn (ZC)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soybeans (ZS)', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(bar_ts, zc_close, zs_close)

# =============================================================================
# 3. CORN (ZC) DETAIL — Price + 20-Day MA + 1yr-Ago Dashed Reference
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn (ZC): Price, 20-Day MA & Year-Ago Reference',
    category='2. Corn (ZC) Detail',
    y_axis_label='Price (cents/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day MA', color=Color.Indigo),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price 1yr Ago', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(bar_ts, zc_close, zc_ma20, zc_price_1yr_ago)

# =============================================================================
# 4. SOYBEANS (ZS) DETAIL — Price + 20-Day MA + 1yr-Ago Dashed Reference
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Price, 20-Day MA & Year-Ago Reference',
    category='3. Soybeans (ZS) Detail',
    y_axis_label='Price (cents/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day MA', color=Color.Indigo),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price 1yr Ago', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(bar_ts, zs_close, zs_ma20, zs_price_1yr_ago)
